name: PLD (prompt lookup) acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, 6 tasks. Average acceptance length τ = 1.69 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 1.64x mean across tasks.
notes: PLD (prompt lookup decoding) uses n-gram retrieval from the prompt as draft. Zero draft model cost. Speedup ≈ acceptance length because draft is nearly free. Highest speedup on summarization (CNN/DM 2.42x) due to high context overlap. Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding.
